name: leela
install:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
command -v uv >/dev/null || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
if [ ! -f ../ramabana/pyproject.toml ]; then
  R="$HOME/ramabana"
  [ -f "$R/pyproject.toml" ] || git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/vedicreader/ramabana.git "$R"
  if ! ln -sfn "$R" ../ramabana 2>/dev/null; then
    [ -d .venv ] || uv venv .venv --python 3.12
    . .venv/bin/activate
    uv pip install -e "$R"
    UV_NO_SOURCES=1 uv pip install -e ".[gateway]" --group test --group dev
    python -m playwright install chromium
    command -v rg >/dev/null || (sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq ripgrep)
    sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq libsqlite3-0 libsqlite3-dev >/dev/null
    exit 0
  fi
fi
